title: षडशीतितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 86 · Yudhishthira sends Satyaki to Arjuna

summary.en: Yudhishthira, uneasy about Arjuna, tells Satyaki to go and learn his fate. Satyaki says he cannot leave the king, whom Arjuna entrusted to him, until Yudhishthira insists and takes responsibility.
summary.kn: ಅರ್ಜುನನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆತಂಕಗೊಂಡ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಅವನ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಲು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅರ್ಜುನ ತನಗೆ ವಹಿಸಿದ ರಾಜನನ್ನು ಬಿಡಲಾರೆನೆಂದು ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸಿ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ಹೊರುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: अर्जुन के लिए व्याकुल युधिष्ठिर सात्यकि से कहते हैं कि जाकर उसका हाल जानो। सात्यकि कहता है कि अर्जुन के सौंपे राजा को वह नहीं छोड़ सकता, जब तक युधिष्ठिर आग्रह कर जिम्मेदारी स्वयं नहीं लेते।
summary.te: అర్జునుని గురించి ఆందోళన చెందిన యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అతని స్థితి తెలుసుకోమని సాత్యకికి చెబుతాడు. అర్జునుడు అప్పగించిన రాజును వదలలేనని సాత్యకి అంటాడు; యుధిష్ఠిరుడు పట్టుబట్టి బాధ్యత తీసుకుంటాడు.
summary.ta: அர்ஜுனனுக்காகக் கவலையுற்ற யுதிஷ்டிரர் அவன் நிலையை அறியச் சாத்யகியிடம் கூறுகிறார். அர்ஜுனன் தன்னிடம் ஒப்படைத்த மன்னரை விட முடியாது என்று சாத்யகி கூற, யுதிஷ்டிரர் வற்புறுத்தி பொறுப்பை ஏற்கிறார்.
summary.ml: അർജുനനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ആശങ്കയിൽ യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ സാത്യകിയോട് പോയി വിവരം അറിയാൻ പറയുന്നു. താൻ രാജാവിനെ വിട്ടുപോകാനാവില്ലെന്ന് സാത്യകി പറയുന്നു; രാജാവ് നിർബന്ധിച്ച് ഉത്തരവാദിത്വം ഏറ്റെടുക്കുമ്പോഴാണ് അദ്ദേഹം അനുസരിക്കുന്നത്.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.86; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
प्रीतियुक्तं च हृद्यं च मधुराक्षरमेव च ।
कालयुक्तं च चित्रं च स्वतया चाभिभाषितम् ॥

meaning.en: The king's words were affectionate, heartfelt, sweet in sound, suited to the moment, and varied, and spoken with real feeling.

verses.text:
धर्मराजस्य तद्वाक्यं निशम्य शिनिपुंगवः ।
सात्यकिर्भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रत्युवाच युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the Dharma king's speech, Satyaki, bull of the Shinis, O best of the Bharatas, replied to Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
श्रुतं ते गदतो वाक्यं सर्वमेतन्मयाच्युत ।
न्याययुक्तं च चित्रं च फल्गुनार्थे यशस्करम् ॥

meaning.en: Unfailing one, I have heard all that you said; it is just, varied, and brings honor in Phalguna's cause.

verses.text:
एवंविधे तथा काले मादृशं प्रेक्ष्य संमतम् ।
वक्तुमर्हसि राजेन्द्र यथा पार्थं तथैव माम् ॥

meaning.en: At such a time, O king of kings, seeing one like me as trusted, you should speak to me just as you would to Partha.

verses.text:
न मे धनंजयस्यार्थे प्राणा रक्ष्याः कथंचन ।
त्वत्प्रयुक्तः पुनरहं किं न कुर्यां महाहवे ॥

meaning.en: My life is not to be spared in any way for Dhananjaya's sake. Sent by you, what would I not do in the great battle?

verses.text:
लोकत्रयं योधयेयं सदेवासुरमानुषम् ।
त्वत्प्रयुक्तो नरेन्द्रेह किमुतैतत्सुदुर्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: Sent by you here, O king, I would fight the three worlds with their gods, asuras and men; how much more this very feeble host.

verses.text:
सुयोधनबलं त्वद्य योधयिष्ये समन्ततः ।
विजेष्ये च रणे राजन्सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ॥

meaning.en: Today I will fight Suyodhana's army on every side and win in the battle, O king; I tell you this truly.

verses.text:
कुशल्यहं कुशलिनं समासाद्य धनंजयम् ।
हते जयद्रथे राजन्पुनरेष्यामि तेऽन्तिकम् ॥

meaning.en: I shall find Dhananjaya safe, and when Jayadratha is dead, O king, I will come back to you, safe myself.

verses.text:
अवश्यं तु मया सर्वं विज्ञाप्यस्त्वं नराधिप ।
वासुदेवस्य यद्वाक्यं फल्गुनस्य च धीमतः ॥

meaning.en: But, O lord of men, I must tell you everything, the words of Vasudeva and of the wise Phalguna.

verses.text:
दृढं त्वभिपरीतोऽहमर्जुनेन पुनः पुनः ।
मध्ये सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य वासुदेवस्य शृण्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna pressed this upon me again and again, firmly, in the middle of the whole army, with Vasudeva listening.

verses.text:
अद्य माधव राजानमप्रमत्तोऽनुपालय ।
आर्यां युद्धे मतिं कृत्वा यावद्धन्मि जयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: "Madhava, today, thinking only of the noble duty in battle, guard the king carefully until I kill Jayadratha.

verses.text:
त्वयि वाहं महाबाहो प्रद्युम्ने वा महारथे ।
नृपं निक्षिप्य गच्छेयं निरपेक्षो जयद्रथम् ॥

meaning.en: Leaving the king in your care, mighty-armed one, or in the care of the great chariot-warrior Pradyumna, I could go after Jayadratha with no worry.

verses.text:
जानीषे हि रणे द्रोणं रभसं श्रेष्ठसंमतम् ।
प्रतिज्ञा चापि ते नित्यं श्रुता द्रोणस्य माधव ॥

meaning.en: You know Drona, rash in battle, held in esteem by the best; and Drona's vow, Madhava, has long been known to you.

verses.text:
ग्रहणं धर्मराजस्य भारद्वाजोऽनुगृध्यति ।
शक्तश्चापि रणे द्रोणो निगृहीतुं युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Bharadvaja's son longs to seize the Dharma king, and Drona is able to take Yudhishthira prisoner in battle.

verses.text:
एवं त्वयि समाधाय धर्मराजं नरोत्तमम् ।
अहमद्य गमिष्यामि सैन्धवस्य वधाय हि ॥

meaning.en: So, with the Dharma king, best of men, left in your care, I shall go today to kill Saindhava.

verses.text:
जयद्रथमहं हत्वा ध्रुवमेष्यामि माधव ।
धर्मराजं यथा द्रोणो निगृह्णीयाद्रणे बलात् ॥

meaning.en: Having killed Jayadratha, I shall surely return, Madhava, if Drona does not by force seize the Dharma king in battle.

verses.text:
निगृहीते नरश्रेष्ठे भारद्वाजेन माधव ।
सैन्धवस्य वधो न स्यान्ममाप्रीतिस्तथा भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: If Bharadvaja's son seizes the best of men, Madhava, Saindhava will not be killed, and I would be displeased.

verses.text:
एवं गते नरश्रेष्ठ पाण्डवे सत्यवादिनि ।
अस्माकं गमनं व्यक्तं वनं प्रति भवेत्पुनः ॥

meaning.en: If that should happen, O best of men, to the truthful Pandava, then clearly we should have to go to the forest again.

verses.text:
सोऽयं मम जयो व्यक्तं व्यर्थ एव भविष्यति ।
यदि द्रोणो रणे क्रुद्धो निगृह्णीयाद्युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Then this victory of mine would clearly come to nothing, if Drona, enraged, were to seize Yudhishthira in battle.

verses.text:
स त्वमद्य महाबाहो प्रियार्थं मम माधव ।
जयार्थं च यशोर्थं च रक्ष राजानमाहवे ॥

meaning.en: So, mighty-armed Madhava, for my sake and for victory and fame, protect the king in the fight.

verses.text:
स भवान्मयि निक्षेपो निक्षिप्तः सव्यसाचिना ।
भारद्वाजाद्भयं नित्यं पश्यमानेन ते प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: You, my lord, have been placed in my care as a trust by Savyasachin, who always sees danger from Bharadvaja's son.

verses.text:
तस्यापि च महाबाहो नित्यं पश्यति संयुगे ।
नान्यं हि प्रतियोद्धारं रौक्मिणेयादृते प्रभो ।
मां वापि मन्यते युद्धे भारद्वाजस्य धीमतः ॥

meaning.en: And he too always sees, in battle, no other opponent for Drona but Rukmini's son, or else me, as the match of the wise Bharadvaja's son.

verses.text:
सोऽहं संभावनां चैतामाचार्यवचनं च तत् ।
पृष्ठतो नोत्सहे कर्तुं त्वां वा त्यक्तुं महीपते ॥

meaning.en: So, trusting that esteem and that teacher's word, I cannot turn my back on you, or leave you, O lord of the earth.

verses.text:
आचार्यो लघुहस्तत्वादभेद्यकवचावृतः ।
उपलभ्य रणे क्रीडेद्यथा शकुनिना शिशुः ॥

meaning.en: The teacher, quick-handed and clad in unbreakable armor, if he finds you in battle, will play with you as a child plays with a bird.

verses.text:
यदि कार्ष्णिर्धनुष्पाणिरिह स्यान्मकरध्वजः ।
तस्मै त्वां विसृजेयं वै स त्वां रक्षेद्यथार्जुनः ॥

meaning.en: If Pradyumna, bearing a bow, he of the makara banner, were here, I would give you into his keeping, and he would guard you as Arjuna does.

verses.text:
कुरु त्वमात्मनो गुप्तिं कस्ते गोप्ता गते मयि ।
यः प्रतीयाद्रणे द्रोणं यावद्गच्छामि पाण्डवम् ॥

meaning.en: Make your own protection secure; who will be your guardian when I am gone, one who could face Drona while I go to the Pandava?

verses.text:
मा च ते भयमद्यास्तु राजन्नर्जुनसंभवम् ।
न स जातु महाबाहुर्भारमुद्यम्य सीदति ॥

meaning.en: Let there be no fear for you today, O king, on Arjuna's account; that mighty-armed one never sinks after taking up a burden.

verses.text:
ये च सौवीरका योधास्तथा सैन्धवपौरवाः ।
उदीच्या दाक्षिणात्याश्च ये चान्येऽपि महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: The Sauvira warriors, the Saindhavas, the Paurava, the northerners, the southerners, and the other great chariot-warriors,

verses.text:
ये च कर्णमुखा राजन्रथोदाराः प्रकीर्तिताः ।
एतेऽर्जुनस्य क्रुद्धस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् ॥

meaning.en: And those led by Karna, famed as noble chariot-fighters, O king, are not worth a sixteenth part of the enraged Arjuna.

verses.text:
उद्युक्ता पृथिवी सर्वा ससुरासुरमानुषा ।
सराक्षसगणा राजन्सकिंनरमहोरगा ॥

meaning.en: The whole earth rising up with gods, asuras and men, with rakshasa hordes, kinnaras and great serpents,

verses.text:
जङ्गमाः स्थावरैः सार्धं नालं पार्थस्य संयुगे ।
एवं ज्ञात्वा महाराज व्येतु ते भीर्धनंजये ॥

meaning.en: The moving and the unmoving together, would not be a match for Partha in battle. Knowing this, great king, put aside fear for Dhananjaya.

verses.text:
यत्र वीरौ महेष्वासौ कृष्णौ सत्यपराक्रमौ ।
न तत्र कर्मणो व्यापत्कथंचिदपि विद्यते ॥

meaning.en: Where the two heroic mighty bowmen, the two Krishnas, of true valor, are, there can be no failure of the undertaking at all.

verses.text:
दैवं कृतास्त्रतां योगममर्षमपि चाहवे ।
कृतज्ञतां दयां चैव भ्रातुस्त्वमनुचिन्तय ॥

meaning.en: Think of the divine nature, the skill in weapons, the discipline, even the wrath in battle, the gratitude and the kindness of your brother.

verses.text:
मयि चाप्यपयाते वै गच्छमानेऽर्जुनं प्रति ।
द्रोणे चित्रास्त्रतां संख्ये राजंस्त्वमनुचिन्तय ॥

meaning.en: And think too, O king, of Drona's marvelous weapons in battle, once I have gone off toward Arjuna.

verses.text:
आचार्यो हि भृशं राजन्निग्रहे तव गृध्यति ।
प्रतिज्ञामात्मनो रक्षन्सत्यां कर्तुं च भारत ॥

meaning.en: For the teacher, O king, is eager indeed to seize you, to protect his own vow and make it come true, Bharata.

verses.text:
कुरुष्वाद्यात्मनो गुप्तिं कस्ते गोप्ता गते मयि ।
यस्याहं प्रत्ययात्पार्थ गच्छेयं फल्गुनं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Make your own protection safe today; who will guard you when I am gone, you in whose trust I could go to Phalguna?

verses.text:
न ह्यहं त्वा महाराज अनिक्षिप्य महाहवे ।
क्वचिद्यास्यामि कौरव्य सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ॥

meaning.en: For I will not go anywhere, great king, scion of Kuru, without leaving you safely placed in this great battle; I tell you this truly.

verses.text:
एतद्विचार्य बहुशो बुद्ध्या बुद्धिमतां वर ।
दृष्ट्वा श्रेयः परं बुद्ध्या ततो राजन्प्रशाधि माम् ॥

meaning.en: Weigh this well, best of the wise, with your mind, and having seen what is higher good, then, O king, command me."

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
एवमेतन्महाबाहो यथा वदसि माधव ।
न तु मे शुध्यते भावः श्वेताश्वं प्रति मारिष ॥

meaning.en: It is as you say, mighty-armed Madhava; but my heart is still not at peace about the white-horsed Arjuna.

verses.text:
करिष्ये परमं यत्नमात्मनो रक्षणं प्रति ।
गच्छ त्वं समनुज्ञातो यत्र यातो धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: I shall make the utmost effort to protect myself. Go, with my leave, where Dhananjaya has gone.

verses.text:
आत्मसंरक्षणं संख्ये गमनं चार्जुनं प्रति ।
विचार्यैतद्द्वयं बुद्ध्या गमनं तत्र रोचये ॥

meaning.en: Weighing the two, protecting myself in battle and going to Arjuna, in my mind, I prefer that you go there.

verses.text:
स त्वमातिष्ठ यानाय यत्र यातो धनंजयः ।
ममापि रक्षणं भीमः करिष्यति महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: So prepare to go where Dhananjaya has gone. Mighty Bhima too will protect me.

verses.text:
पार्षतश्च ससोदर्यः पार्थिवाश्च महाबलाः ।
द्रौपदेयाश्च मां तात रक्षिष्यन्ति न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: Prishata's son with his brothers, the mighty kings, and the sons of Draupadi, my friend, will surely protect me.

verses.text:
केकया भ्रातरः पञ्च राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः ।
विराटो द्रुपदश्चैव शिखण्डी च महारथः ॥

meaning.en: The five Kekaya brothers, the rakshasa Ghatotkacha, Virata, Drupada, and the great chariot-warrior Shikhandi,

verses.text:
धृष्टकेतुश्च बलवान्कुन्तिभोजश्च मारिष ।
नकुलः सहदेवश्च पाञ्चालाः सृञ्जयास्तथा ।
एते समाहितास्तात रक्षिष्यन्ति न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: The strong Dhrishtaketu, Kuntibhoja, Nakula, Sahadeva, the Panchalas and the Srinjayas: all these, alert, will surely protect me.

verses.text:
न द्रोणः सह सैन्येन कृतवर्मा च संयुगे ।
समासादयितुं शक्तो न च मां धर्षयिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Neither Drona with his army nor Kritavarman will be able to get at me in battle, nor will they overpower me.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नश्च समरे द्रोणं क्रुद्धं परंतपः ।
वारयिष्यति विक्रम्य वेलेव मकरालयम् ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtadyumna, the scorcher of foes, will check the angry Drona with his valor in the fight, as the shore checks the sea.

verses.text:
यत्र स्थास्यति संग्रामे पार्षतः परवीरहा ।
न द्रोणसैन्यं बलवत्क्रामेत्तत्र कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Wherever Prishata's son, slayer of enemy heroes, stands in battle, Drona's mighty army can in no way advance there.

verses.text:
एष द्रोणविनाशाय समुत्पन्नो हुताशनात् ।
कवची स शरी खड्गी धन्वी च वरभूषणः ॥

meaning.en: He was born from the fire to destroy Drona, armored, with arrows, sword and bow, adorned with fine ornaments.

verses.text:
विश्रब्धो गच्छ शैनेय मा कार्षीर्मयि संभ्रमम् ।
धृष्टद्युम्नो रणे क्रुद्धो द्रोणमावारयिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Go without anxiety, Shaineya, and do not be flustered about me. Dhrishtadyumna, enraged in battle, will hold Drona back.
